question.text:
In how many ways can eight distinct people be separated into four unlabeled pairs?
(A) 70 (B) 105 (C) 210 (D) 420 (E) 2520

solution.text:
Order all eight people, group consecutive pairs, and divide by 2! for each pair and 4! for
4
permutation of the four pairs. The result is 8!/[(2!) 4!] = 105.

question.text:
Eight distinct people are assigned to labeled teams A, B, C of sizes 3, 3, 2, respectively. Two
specified people must be together on one of the three-person teams. How many assignments are
possible?
(A) 60 (B) 90 (C) 120 (D) 240 (E) 560

solution.text:
Choose which of A, B contains the specified pair (two choices), then its third member (six
choices). From the five remaining people choose three for the other labeled three-person
